WCD Janjgir-Champa Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available for the Child Helpline Supervisor post under the Child Help Line Unit - Janjgir-Champa (Chhattisgarh).

content_sections.heading: WCD Janjgir-Champa Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be local residents of Chhattisgarh. A domicile certificate issued by a competent authority is mandatory.

rows.qualification_required: Degree in Social Work / Computer Science / Information Technology / Community Science / Sociology / Social Work / Social Science / Social Science in Psychology from a recognized university. Candidates must have good knowledge of computers and MS Office working skills. Preference will be given to experienced candidates and those who have worked in the field of emergency helplines.

content_sections.heading: WCD Janjgir-Champa Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 21 years and 35 years of age as of 01-01-2026. Under no circumstances, including relaxations, shall the maximum age exceed 45 years.

content_sections.text: No additional allowances or benefits are mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: WCD Janjgir-Champa Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: WCD Janjgir-Champa Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of merit list preparation based on educational qualification marks, experience marks, and personal interview/skill test marks where applicable. 60 percent weightage is given to the percentage of marks obtained in the mandatory minimum educational qualification. No marks are awarded for the mandatory minimum experience. However, 02 marks are awarded for each year of experience beyond the mandatory minimum, up to a maximum of 10 marks. Emergency helpline field experience receives 02 bonus marks per year, up to a maximum of 10 marks. Personal interview or skill test carries 20 marks where conducted. For posts where both interview and skill test are conducted, each carries 10 marks. Candidates are called for personal interview or skill test in the ratio of 1:5 based on merit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WCD Janjgir-Champa
content_sections.text: Download the application form and notification from the official website janjgir-champa.gov.in or the official PDF Official Notification PDF . Fill out the prescribed application format clearly and correctly. Self-attest copies of all required educational, experience, caste, and residency documents. Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph with signature across the lower half on the designated space of the application form. Write the name of the post and sender's address clearly on the envelope. Send the completed application form via registered post, speed post, or courier to the office of the District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development Department, Janjgir-Champa (Chhattisgarh) on or before 23-10-2026 by 05:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Birth certificate or Class 10th marksheet for age proof Class 10th marksheet Class 12th marksheet Professional course certificate Domicile certificate Experience certificates issued by the competent authority of the associated organisation Identity card / Aadhaar card / Voter ID card Self-addressed envelope with Rs. 10 postage stamp

content_sections.heading: WCD Janjgir-Champa Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received directly at office counters will not be accepted. Incomplete, illegible, or defective applications will be rejected without notice. Only full-time experience certificates issued by authorised employers are valid. Voluntary service certificates are not considered as valid experience. Employees working in government or semi-government institutions must submit their application through proper channel along with a No Objection Certificate from their employer. Contract appointment is initially for a maximum of 3 years or until the scheme operation by the Government of India, whichever is earlier. The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. What is the WCD Janjgir-Champa Child Helpline Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an offline recruitment notification issued by the Women and Child Development Department, Janjgir-Champa, to fill 1 Child Helpline Supervisor post under Mission Vatsalya.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy is available for the Child Helpline Supervisor post, reserved for the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications is 23-10-2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Child Helpline Supervisor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a degree in Social Work, Computer Science, Information Technology, Community Science, Sociology, Social Science, or Social Science in Psychology from a recognized university, along with computer and MS Office skills.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 21 and 35 years of age as of 01-01-2026, with an absolute maximum cap of 45 years including relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this vacancy?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their completed offline application forms through registered post, speed post, or courier to the specified district office address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary for the Child Helpline Supervisor post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 22000/-.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a written examination for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection is based on a merit list prepared using educational qualification marks, experience marks, and a personal interview or skill test where applicable, rather than a standalone written exam.

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only local residents of Chhattisgarh holding a valid domicile certificate are eligible to apply.
